Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.

content.latin: Psalmus 62 [3]
content.english: Psalm 62 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 62

content.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
content.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.

content.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
content.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

segments.t: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.

content.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
content.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

segments.t: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.

content.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
content.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

segments.t: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.

content.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
content.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

segments.t: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.

content.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
content.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

segments.t: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.

content.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
content.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

segments.t: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.

content.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
content.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

segments.t: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
content.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

segments.t: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.

content.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
content.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

segments.t: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Et ecce apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.
content.english: Ant. And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias, talking with Jesus.

segments.t: Ant.
Et ecce apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.

content.latin: Ant. Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.
content.english: Ant. Then answered Peter, * and said unto Jesus: Lord, it is good for us to be here.

segments.t: Ant.
Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.

content.latin: Canticum Trium Puerorum [4]
content.english: Canticle of the Three Young Men [4]

segments.t: Canticum Trium Puerorum

content.latin: 3:57 Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:57 All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:58 Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:58 O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

segments.t: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:59 Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:59 O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:60 Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:60 O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:61 Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
content.english: 3:61 O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:62 Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:62 O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:63 Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:63 O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:64 Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
content.english: 3:64 O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:65 Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
content.english: 3:65 O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:66 Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:66 O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:67 Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
content.english: 3:67 O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:68 Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
content.english: 3:68 O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:69 Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:70 Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
content.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:71 Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:73 Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
content.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:74 Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:75 (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:)
Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:56 Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:56 Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

segments.t: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.

content.latin: Ant. Respóndens autem Petrus, dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.
content.english: Ant. Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus: Lord, it is good for us to be here.

segments.t: Ant.
Respóndens autem Petrus, dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.

content.latin: Ant. Adhuc eo loquénte, * ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.
content.english: Ant. While he yet spake, * behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them.

segments.t: Ant.
Adhuc eo loquénte, * ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 148 [5]
content.english: Psalm 148 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 148

content.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
content.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.

content.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
content.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.

content.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
content.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.

content.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
content.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

segments.t: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
content.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.t: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.

content.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
content.english: 148:7 Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.

content.latin: 148:8 Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
content.english: 148:8 Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

segments.t: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:

content.latin: 148:9 Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
content.english: 148:9 Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

segments.t: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.

content.latin: 148:10 Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
content.english: 148:10 Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

segments.t: Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:

content.latin: 148:11 Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.
content.english: 148:11 Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:

segments.t: Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.

content.latin: 148:12 Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
content.english: 148:12 Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.

segments.t: Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.

content.latin: 148:14 Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
content.english: 148:14 The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.

segments.t: Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.

content.latin: 148:14 Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
content.english: 148:14 A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

segments.t: Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Adhuc eo loquénte, ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.
content.english: Ant. While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them.

segments.t: Ant.
Adhuc eo loquénte, ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.

content.latin: Salvatórem exspectámus Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, qui reformábit corpus humilitátis nostræ configurátum córpori claritátis suæ.
content.english: We look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious Body.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Lux alma, Iesu, méntium,
content.english: Light of the anxious heart,

content.latin: Dum corda nostra récreas,
content.english: Jesus, thou dost appear,

content.latin: Culpæ fugas calíginem,
content.english: To bid the gloom of guilt depart,

content.latin: Et nos reples dulcédine.
content.english: And shed thy sweetness here.

content.latin: Quam lætus est, quem vísitas!
content.english: Joyous is he, with whom,

content.latin: Consors Patérnæ déxteræ,
content.english: God's Word, thou dost abide;

content.latin: Tu dulce lumen pátriæ,
content.english: Sweet light of our eternal home,

content.latin: Carnis negátum sénsibus.
content.english: To fleshly sense denied.

content.latin: Splendor Patérnæ glóriæ,
content.english: Brightness of God above!

content.latin: Incomprehénsa cáritas,
content.english: Unfathomable grace!

content.latin: Nobis amóris cópiam
content.english: thy presence be a fount of love

content.latin: Largíre per præséntiam.
content.english: Within thy chosen place.

content.latin: Iesu, tibi sit glória,
content.english: To thee, whom children see,

content.latin: Qui te revélas párvulis,
content.english: The Father ever blest,

content.latin: Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
content.english: The Holy Spirit, One and Three,

content.latin: In sempitérna sǽcula.
content.english: Be endless praise addrest.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Coróna áurea super caput eius.
content.english: ℣. A crown of gold upon his head.

segments.t: Coróna áurea super caput eius.

content.latin: ℟. Expréssa signo sanctitátis, glóriæ, et honóris.
content.english: ℟. Wherein was engraved holiness, glory, and honour.

segments.t: Expréssa signo sanctitátis, glóriæ, et honóris.

content.latin: Ant. Et ecce, * vox de nube dicens: Hic est Fílius meus diléctus, in quo mihi complácui; ipsum audíte, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. And, behold, a voice out of the cloud, * which said: This is My beloved Son, in Whom I am well pleased; hear ye Him, alleluia.

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

segments.t: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.

content.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
content.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.

content.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
content.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

content.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
content.english: 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.latin: 1:78 Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
content.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

segments.t: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.latin: 1:79 Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
content.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui fídei sacraménta in Unigéniti tui gloriósa Transfiguratióne patrum testimónio roborásti, et adoptiónem filiórum perféctam, voce delápsa in nube lúcida, mirabíliter præsignásti: concéde propítius; ut ipsíus Regis glóriæ nos coherédes effícias, et eiúsdem glóriæ tríbuas esse consórtes.
content.english: O God, Who, in the glorious Transfiguration of thine Only Begotten Son didst attest the mysteries of the Faith by the witness of the Fathers, and didst wonderfully signify by a voice out of a bright cloud, the adoption of sons, mercifully grant unto us to be made co-heirs with the very King of glory, and bestow upon us a partaking of His glory.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.latin: Deum precémur súpplices,
content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.latin: Ut in diúrnis áctibus
content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.latin: Nos servet a nocéntibus.
content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.latin: Linguam refrénans témperet,
content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.latin: Ne litis horror ínsonet:
content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.latin: Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.latin: Ne vanitátes háuriat.
content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Carnis terat supérbiam
content.english: Scant need of food, excess denied,

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.
content.english: Wear down in us the body's pride.

content.latin: Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: Noctémque sors redúxerit,
content.english: And night in course shall follow on.

content.latin: Mundi per abstinéntiam
content.english: We, free from cares the world affords,

content.latin: Ipsi canámus glóriam.
content.english: May chant the praise that is our Lord's.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: All laud to God the Father be,

content.latin: Eiúsque soli Fílio,
content.english: All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:

content.latin: 22:1 Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit: * in loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
content.english: 22:1 The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing. * He hath set me in a place of pasture.

segments.t: Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit: * in loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.

content.latin: 22:2 Super aquam refectiónis educávit me: * ánimam meam convértit.
content.english: 22:2 He hath brought me up, on the water of refreshment: * he hath converted my soul.

segments.t: Super aquam refectiónis educávit me: * ánimam meam convértit.

content.latin: 22:3 Dedúxit me super sémitas iustítiæ, * propter nomen suum.
content.english: 22:3 He hath led me on the paths of justice, * for his own name’s sake.

segments.t: Dedúxit me super sémitas iustítiæ, * propter nomen suum.

content.latin: 22:4 Nam, et si ambulávero in médio umbræ mortis, non timébo mala: * quóniam tu mecum es.
content.english: 22:4 For though I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evils, * for thou art with me.

segments.t: Nam, et si ambulávero in médio umbræ mortis, non timébo mala: * quóniam tu mecum es.

content.latin: 22:4 Virga tua, et báculus tuus: * ipsa me consoláta sunt.
content.english: 22:4 Thy rod and thy staff, * they have comforted me.

segments.t: Virga tua, et báculus tuus: * ipsa me consoláta sunt.

content.latin: 22:5 Parásti in conspéctu meo mensam, * advérsus eos, qui tríbulant me.
content.english: 22:5 Thou hast prepared a table before me * against them that afflict me.

segments.t: Parásti in conspéctu meo mensam, * advérsus eos, qui tríbulant me.

content.latin: 22:5 Impinguásti in óleo caput meum: * et calix meus inébrians quam præclárus est!
content.english: 22:5 Thou hast anointed my head with oil; * and my chalice which inebriateth me, how goodly is it!

segments.t: Impinguásti in óleo caput meum: * et calix meus inébrians quam præclárus est!

content.latin: 22:6 Et misericórdia tua subsequétur me * ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ:
content.english: 22:6 And thy mercy will follow me * all the days of my life.

segments.t: Et misericórdia tua subsequétur me * ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ:

content.latin: 22:6 Et ut inhábitem in domo Dómini, * in longitúdinem diérum.
content.english: 22:6 And that I may dwell in the house of the Lord * unto length of days.

segments.t: Et ut inhábitem in domo Dómini, * in longitúdinem diérum.

content.latin: 71:2 Deus, iudícium tuum regi da: * et iustítiam tuam fílio regis:
content.english: 71:2 Give to the king thy judgment, O God: * and to the king’s son thy justice:

segments.t: Deus, iudícium tuum regi da: * et iustítiam tuam fílio regis:

content.latin: 71:2 Iudicáre pópulum tuum in iustítia, * et páuperes tuos in iudício.
content.english: 71:2 To judge thy people with justice, * and thy poor with judgment.

segments.t: Iudicáre pópulum tuum in iustítia, * et páuperes tuos in iudício.

content.latin: 71:3 Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo: * et colles iustítiam.
content.english: 71:3 Let the mountains receive peace for the people: * and the hills justice.

segments.t: Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo: * et colles iustítiam.

content.latin: 71:4 Iudicábit páuperes pópuli, et salvos fáciet fílios páuperum: * et humiliábit calumniatórem.
content.english: 71:4 He shall judge the poor of the people, and he shall save the children of the poor: * and he shall humble the oppressor.

segments.t: Iudicábit páuperes pópuli, et salvos fáciet fílios páuperum: * et humiliábit calumniatórem.

content.latin: 71:5 Et permanébit cum sole, et ante lunam, * in generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 71:5 And he shall continue with the sun, and before the moon, * throughout all generations.

segments.t: Et permanébit cum sole, et ante lunam, * in generatióne et generatiónem.

content.latin: 71:6 Descéndet sicut plúvia in vellus: * et sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram.
content.english: 71:6 He shall come down like rain upon the fleece; * and as showers falling gently upon the earth.

segments.t: Descéndet sicut plúvia in vellus: * et sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram.

content.latin: 71:7 Oriétur in diébus eius iustítia, et abundántia pacis: * donec auferátur luna.
content.english: 71:7 In his days shall justice spring up, and abundance of peace, * till the moon be taken away.

segments.t: Oriétur in diébus eius iustítia, et abundántia pacis: * donec auferátur luna.

content.latin: 71:8 Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare: * et a flúmine usque ad términos orbis terrárum.
content.english: 71:8 And he shall rule from sea to sea, * and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

segments.t: Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare: * et a flúmine usque ad términos orbis terrárum.

content.latin: 71:9 Coram illo prócident Æthíopes: * et inimíci eius terram lingent.
content.english: 71:9 Before him the Ethiopians shall fall down: * and his enemies shall lick the ground.

segments.t: Coram illo prócident Æthíopes: * et inimíci eius terram lingent.

content.latin: 71:10 Reges Tharsis, et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent.
content.english: 71:10 The kings of Tharsis and the islands shall offer presents: * the kings of the Arabians and of Saba shall bring gifts:

segments.t: Reges Tharsis, et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent.

content.latin: 71:11 Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei:
content.english: 71:11 And all kings of the earth shall adore him: * all nations shall serve him.

segments.t: Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei:

content.latin: 71:12 Quia liberábit páuperem a poténte: * et páuperem, cui non erat adiútor.
content.english: 71:12 For he shall deliver the poor from the mighty: * and the needy that had no helper.

segments.t: Quia liberábit páuperem a poténte: * et páuperem, cui non erat adiútor.

content.latin: 71:13 Parcet páuperi et ínopi: * et ánimas páuperum salvas fáciet.
content.english: 71:13 He shall spare the poor and needy: * and he shall save the souls of the poor.

segments.t: Parcet páuperi et ínopi: * et ánimas páuperum salvas fáciet.

content.latin: 71:14 Ex usúris et iniquitáte rédimet ánimas eórum: * et honorábile nomen eórum coram illo.
content.english: 71:14 He shall redeem their souls from usuries and iniquity: * and their names shall be honourable in his sight.

segments.t: Ex usúris et iniquitáte rédimet ánimas eórum: * et honorábile nomen eórum coram illo.

content.latin: 71:15 Et vivet, et dábitur ei de auro Arábiæ, et adorábunt de ipso semper: * tota die benedícent ei.
content.english: 71:15 And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Arabia, for him they shall always adore: * they shall bless him all the day.

segments.t: Et vivet, et dábitur ei de auro Arábiæ, et adorábunt de ipso semper: * tota die benedícent ei.

content.latin: 71:16 Et erit firmaméntum in terra in summis móntium, superextollétur super Líbanum fructus eius: * et florébunt de civitáte sicut fænum terræ.
content.english: 71:16 And there shall be a firmament on the earth on the tops of mountains, above Libanus shall the fruit thereof be exalted: * and they of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

segments.t: Et erit firmaméntum in terra in summis móntium, superextollétur super Líbanum fructus eius: * et florébunt de civitáte sicut fænum terræ.

content.latin: 71:17 Sit nomen eius benedíctum in sǽcula: * ante solem pérmanet nomen eius.
content.english: 71:17 Let his name be blessed for evermore: * his name continueth before the sun.

segments.t: Sit nomen eius benedíctum in sǽcula: * ante solem pérmanet nomen eius.

content.latin: 71:17 Et benedicéntur in ipso omnes tribus terræ: * omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.
content.english: 71:17 And in him shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed: * all nations shall magnify him.

segments.t: Et benedicéntur in ipso omnes tribus terræ: * omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.

content.latin: 71:18 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus:
content.english: 71:18 Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, * who alone doth wonderful things.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus:

content.latin: 71:19 Et benedíctum nomen maiestátis eius in ætérnum: * et replébitur maiestáte eius omnis terra: fiat, fiat.
content.english: 71:19 And blessed be the name of his majesty for ever: * and the whole earth shall be filled with his majesty. So be it. So be it.

segments.t: Et benedíctum nomen maiestátis eius in ætérnum: * et replébitur maiestáte eius omnis terra: fiat, fiat.

content.latin: Arétii, in Túscia, natális sancti Donáti, Epíscopi et Mártyris; qui, inter cétera virtútis ópera (ut scribit beátus Gregórius Papa), cálicem sanctum, a Pagánis fractum, orándo instaurávit. Is, in persecutióne Iuliáni Apóstatæ, a Quadratiáno Augustáli comprehénsus, et, cum sacrificáre idólis renuísset, gládio percússus, martýrium consummávit. Passus est étiam cum eo beátus Hilarínus Mónachus; cuius memória décimo séptimo Kaléndas Augústi recólitur, quo die sacrum ipsíus corpus ad Ostia Tiberína translátum fuit.
content.english: At Arezzo, in Tuscany, [in the year 362,] the holy martyr Donatus, Bishop [of that see.], who among other miraculous deeds, by his prayers (as is related by blessed Pope Gregory) made whole again a sacred chalice which had been broken by pagans. He was arrested by the imperial officer Quadratian in the persecution under the Emperor Julian the Apostate, and for as much as he refused to sacrifice to idols he was beheaded, and so finished his testimony. There suffered also along with him the blessed monk Hilarinus, whose feast is kept upon the 16th day of July, being the day whereon his body was brought to Ostia.

content.latin: 72:10 Ídeo convertétur pópulus meus hic: * et dies pleni inveniéntur in eis.
content.english: 72:10 Therefore will my people return here * and full days shall be found in them.

segments.t: Ídeo convertétur pópulus meus hic: * et dies pleni inveniéntur in eis.

content.latin: 72:11 Et dixérunt: Quómodo scit Deus, * et si est sciéntia in excélso?
content.english: 72:11 And they said: How doth God know? * and is there knowledge in the most High?

segments.t: Et dixérunt: Quómodo scit Deus, * et si est sciéntia in excélso?

content.latin: 72:12 Ecce, ipsi peccatóres, et abundántes in sǽculo, * obtinuérunt divítias.
content.english: 72:12 Behold these are sinners; and yet abounding in the world * they have obtained riches.

segments.t: Ecce, ipsi peccatóres, et abundántes in sǽculo, * obtinuérunt divítias.

content.latin: 72:13 Et dixi: Ergo sine causa iustificávi cor meum, * et lavi inter innocéntes manus meas:
content.english: 72:13 And I said: Then have I in vain justified my heart, * and washed my hands among the innocent.

segments.t: Et dixi: Ergo sine causa iustificávi cor meum, * et lavi inter innocéntes manus meas:

content.latin: 72:14 Et fui flagellátus tota die, * et castigátio mea in matutínis.
content.english: 72:14 And I have been scourged all the day; * and my chastisement hath been in the mornings.

segments.t: Et fui flagellátus tota die, * et castigátio mea in matutínis.

content.latin: 72:15 Si dicébam: Narrábo sic: * ecce, natiónem filiórum tuórum reprobávi.
content.english: 72:15 If I said: I will speak thus; * behold I should condemn the generation of thy children.

segments.t: Si dicébam: Narrábo sic: * ecce, natiónem filiórum tuórum reprobávi.

content.latin: 72:16 Existimábam ut cognóscerem hoc, * labor est ante me:
content.english: 72:16 I studied that I might know this thing, * it is a labour in my sight:

segments.t: Existimábam ut cognóscerem hoc, * labor est ante me:

content.latin: 72:17 Donec intrem in Sanctuárium Dei: * et intéllegam in novíssimis eórum.
content.english: 72:17 Until I go into the sanctuary of God, * and understand concerning their last ends.

segments.t: Donec intrem in Sanctuárium Dei: * et intéllegam in novíssimis eórum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 72(18-28)

content.latin: 72:18 Verúmtamen propter dolos posuísti eis: * deiecísti eos dum allevaréntur.
content.english: 72:18 But indeed for deceits thou hast put it to them: * when they were lifted up, thou hast cast them down.

segments.t: Verúmtamen propter dolos posuísti eis: * deiecísti eos dum allevaréntur.

content.latin: 72:19 Quómodo facti sunt in desolatiónem, súbito defecérunt: * periérunt propter iniquitátem suam.
content.english: 72:19 How are they brought to desolation? they have suddenly ceased to be: * they have perished by reason of their iniquity.

segments.t: Quómodo facti sunt in desolatiónem, súbito defecérunt: * periérunt propter iniquitátem suam.

content.latin: 72:20 Velut sómnium surgéntium, Dómine, * in civitáte tua imáginem ipsórum ad níhilum rédiges.
content.english: 72:20 As the dream of them that awake, O Lord; * so in thy city thou shalt bring their image to nothing.

segments.t: Velut sómnium surgéntium, Dómine, * in civitáte tua imáginem ipsórum ad níhilum rédiges.

content.latin: 72:21 Quia inflammátum est cor meum, et renes mei commutáti sunt: * et ego ad níhilum redáctus sum, et nescívi.
content.english: 72:21 For my heart hath been inflamed, and my reins have been changed: * and I am brought to nothing, and I knew not.

segments.t: Quia inflammátum est cor meum, et renes mei commutáti sunt: * et ego ad níhilum redáctus sum, et nescívi.

content.latin: 72:23 Ut iuméntum factus sum apud te: * et ego semper tecum.
content.english: 72:23 I am become as a beast before thee: * and I am always with thee.

segments.t: Ut iuméntum factus sum apud te: * et ego semper tecum.

content.latin: 72:24 Tenuísti manum déxteram meam: et in voluntáte tua deduxísti me, * et cum glória suscepísti me.
content.english: 72:24 Thou hast held me by my right hand; and by thy will thou hast conducted me, * and with thy glory thou hast received me.

segments.t: Tenuísti manum déxteram meam: et in voluntáte tua deduxísti me, * et cum glória suscepísti me.

content.latin: 72:25 Quid enim mihi est in cælo? * et a te quid vólui super terram?
content.english: 72:25 For what have I in heaven? * and besides thee what do I desire upon earth?

segments.t: Quid enim mihi est in cælo? * et a te quid vólui super terram?

content.latin: 72:26 Defécit caro mea, et cor meum: * Deus cordis mei, et pars mea Deus in ætérnum.
content.english: 72:26 For thee my flesh and my heart hath fainted away: * thou art the God of my heart, and the God that is my portion for ever.

segments.t: Defécit caro mea, et cor meum: * Deus cordis mei, et pars mea Deus in ætérnum.

content.latin: 72:27 Quia ecce, qui elóngant se a te, períbunt: * perdidísti omnes, qui fornicántur abs te.
content.english: 72:27 For behold they that go far from thee shall perish: * thou hast destroyed all them that are disloyal to thee.

segments.t: Quia ecce, qui elóngant se a te, períbunt: * perdidísti omnes, qui fornicántur abs te.

content.latin: 72:28 Mihi autem adhærére Deo bonum est: * pónere in Dómino Deo spem meam:
content.english: 72:28 But it is good for me to adhere to my God, * to put my hope in the Lord God:

segments.t: Mihi autem adhærére Deo bonum est: * pónere in Dómino Deo spem meam:

content.latin: 72:28 Ut annúntiem omnes prædicatiónes tuas, * in portis fíliæ Sion.
content.english: 72:28 That I may declare all thy praises, * in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

segments.t: Ut annúntiem omnes prædicatiónes tuas, * in portis fíliæ Sion.

content.latin: Ant. Quam bonus Israël Deus, his, qui recto sunt corde.
content.english: Ant. How good is God to Israel, to them that are of a right heart!

segments.t: Ant.
Quam bonus Israël Deus, his, qui recto sunt corde.

content.latin: Salvatórem exspectámus Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, qui reformábit corpus humilitátis nostræ configurátum córpori claritátis suæ.
content.english: We look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious Body.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.english: ℟.br. Thou wast manifested in thy glory in the Presence of the Lord. * Alleluia, Alleluia.

segments.t: ℟.br.
Gloriósus apparuísti in conspéctu Dómini, * Allelúia, allelúia.

content.english: ℣. Wherefore the Lord hath clothed thee with majesty.

content.latin: ℣. Glória et honóre coronásti eum, Dómine.
content.english: ℣. Thou hast crowned him with glory and honour, O Lord.

segments.t: Glória et honóre coronásti eum, Dómine.

content.latin: ℟. Et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
content.english: ℟. And madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

segments.t: Et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui fídei sacraménta in Unigéniti tui gloriósa Transfiguratióne patrum testimónio roborásti, et adoptiónem filiórum perféctam, voce delápsa in nube lúcida, mirabíliter præsignásti: concéde propítius; ut ipsíus Regis glóriæ nos coherédes effícias, et eiúsdem glóriæ tríbuas esse consórtes.
content.english: O God, Who, in the glorious Transfiguration of thine Only Begotten Son didst attest the mysteries of the Faith by the witness of the Fathers, and didst wonderfully signify by a voice out of a bright cloud, the adoption of sons, mercifully grant unto us to be made co-heirs with the very King of glory, and bestow upon us a partaking of His glory.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rector potens, verax Deus,
content.english: O God of truth, O Lord of might,

content.latin: Qui témperas rerum vices,
content.english: Who orderest time and change aright,

content.latin: Splendóre mane illúminas,
content.english: Who send’st the early morning ray,

content.latin: Et ígnibus merídiem:
content.english: And light’st the glow of perfect day:

content.latin: Exstíngue flammas lítium,
content.english: Extinguish thou each sinful fire,

content.latin: Aufer calórem nóxium,
content.english: And banish every ill desire;

content.latin: Confer salútem córporum,
content.english: And while thou keep’st the body whole,

content.latin: Verámque pacem córdium.
content.english: Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Almighty Father, hear our cry,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Memor esto * congregatiónis tuæ, Dómine, quam possedísti ab inítio.
content.english: Ant. Remember * thy congregation, which thou hast possessed from the beginning.

Memor esto * congregatiónis tuæ, Dómine, quam possedísti ab inítio.

content.latin: Psalmus 73(1-9) [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 73(1-9)

content.latin: 73:1 Ut quid, Deus, repulísti in finem: * irátus est furor tuus super oves páscuæ tuæ?
content.english: 73:1 O God, why hast thou cast us off unto the end: * why is thy wrath enkindled against the sheep of thy pasture?

segments.t: Ut quid, Deus, repulísti in finem: * irátus est furor tuus super oves páscuæ tuæ?

content.latin: 73:2 Memor esto congregatiónis tuæ, * quam possedísti ab inítio.
content.english: 73:2 Remember thy congregation, * which thou hast possessed from the beginning.

segments.t: Memor esto congregatiónis tuæ, * quam possedísti ab inítio.

content.latin: 73:2 Redemísti virgam hereditátis tuæ: * mons Sion, in quo habitásti in eo.
content.english: 73:2 The sceptre of thy inheritance which thou hast redeemed: * mount Sion in which thou hast dwelt.

segments.t: Redemísti virgam hereditátis tuæ: * mons Sion, in quo habitásti in eo.

content.latin: 73:3 Leva manus tuas in supérbias eórum in finem: * quanta malignátus est inimícus in sancto!
content.english: 73:3 Lift up thy hands against their pride unto the end; * see what things the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

segments.t: Leva manus tuas in supérbias eórum in finem: * quanta malignátus est inimícus in sancto!

content.latin: 73:4 Et gloriáti sunt qui odérunt te: * in médio solemnitátis tuæ.
content.english: 73:4 And they that hate thee have made their boasts, * in the midst of thy solemnity.

segments.t: Et gloriáti sunt qui odérunt te: * in médio solemnitátis tuæ.

content.latin: 73:5 Posuérunt signa sua, signa: * et non cognovérunt sicut in éxitu super summum.
content.english: 73:5 They have set up their ensigns for signs, * and they knew not both in the going out and on the highest top.

segments.t: Posuérunt signa sua, signa: * et non cognovérunt sicut in éxitu super summum.

content.latin: 73:6 Quasi in silva lignórum secúribus excidérunt iánuas eius in idípsum: * in secúri et áscia deiecérunt eam.
content.english: 73:6 As with axes in a wood of trees, they have cut down at once the gates thereof, * with axe and hatchet they have brought it down.

segments.t: Quasi in silva lignórum secúribus excidérunt iánuas eius in idípsum: * in secúri et áscia deiecérunt eam.

content.latin: 73:7 Incendérunt igni Sanctuárium tuum: * in terra polluérunt tabernáculum nóminis tui.
content.english: 73:7 They have set fire to thy sanctuary: * they have defiled the dwelling place of thy name on the earth.

segments.t: Incendérunt igni Sanctuárium tuum: * in terra polluérunt tabernáculum nóminis tui.

content.latin: 73:8 Dixérunt in corde suo cognátio eórum simul: * Quiéscere faciámus omnes dies festos Dei a terra.
content.english: 73:8 They said in their heart, the whole kindred of them together: * Let us abolish all the festival days of God from the land.

segments.t: Dixérunt in corde suo cognátio eórum simul: * Quiéscere faciámus omnes dies festos Dei a terra.

content.latin: 73:9 Signa nostra non vídimus, iam non est prophéta: * et nos non cognóscet ámplius.
content.english: 73:9 Our signs we have not seen, there is now no prophet: * and he will know us no more.

segments.t: Signa nostra non vídimus, iam non est prophéta: * et nos non cognóscet ámplius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Psalmus 73(10-17)

content.latin: 73:10 Úsquequo, Deus, improperábit inimícus: * irrítat adversárius nomen tuum in finem?
content.english: 73:10 How long, O God, shall the enemy reproach: * is the adversary to provoke thy name for ever?

segments.t: Úsquequo, Deus, improperábit inimícus: * irrítat adversárius nomen tuum in finem?

content.latin: 73:11 Ut quid avértis manum tuam, et déxteram tuam, * de médio sinu tuo in finem?
content.english: 73:11 Why dost thou turn away thy hand: and thy right hand * out of the midst of thy bosom for ever?

segments.t: Ut quid avértis manum tuam, et déxteram tuam, * de médio sinu tuo in finem?

content.latin: 73:12 Deus autem Rex noster ante sǽcula: * operátus est salútem in médio terræ.
content.english: 73:12 But God is our king before ages: * he hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.

segments.t: Deus autem Rex noster ante sǽcula: * operátus est salútem in médio terræ.

content.latin: 73:13 Tu confirmásti in virtúte tua mare: * contribulásti cápita dracónum in aquis.
content.english: 73:13 Thou by thy strength didst make the sea firm: * thou didst crush the heads of the dragons in the waters.

segments.t: Tu confirmásti in virtúte tua mare: * contribulásti cápita dracónum in aquis.

content.latin: 73:14 Tu confregísti cápita dracónis: * dedísti eum escam pópulis Æthíopum.
content.english: 73:14 Thou hast broken the heads of the dragon: * thou hast given him to be meat for the people of the Ethiopians.

segments.t: Tu confregísti cápita dracónis: * dedísti eum escam pópulis Æthíopum.

content.latin: 73:15 Tu dirupísti fontes, et torréntes: * tu siccásti flúvios Ethan.
content.english: 73:15 Thou hast broken up the fountains and the torrents: * thou hast dried up the Ethan rivers.

segments.t: Tu dirupísti fontes, et torréntes: * tu siccásti flúvios Ethan.

content.latin: 73:16 Tuus est dies, et tua est nox: * tu fabricátus es auróram et solem.
content.english: 73:16 Thine is the day, and thine is the night: * thou hast made the morning light and the sun.

segments.t: Tuus est dies, et tua est nox: * tu fabricátus es auróram et solem.

content.latin: 73:17 Tu fecísti omnes términos terræ: * æstátem et ver tu plasmásti ea.
content.english: 73:17 Thou hast made all the borders of the earth: * the summer and the spring were formed by thee.

segments.t: Tu fecísti omnes términos terræ: * æstátem et ver tu plasmásti ea.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 73(18-23)

content.latin: 73:18 Memor esto huius, inimícus improperávit Dómino: * et pópulus insípiens incitávit nomen tuum.
content.english: 73:18 Remember this, the enemy hath reproached the Lord: * and a foolish people hath provoked thy name.

segments.t: Memor esto huius, inimícus improperávit Dómino: * et pópulus insípiens incitávit nomen tuum.

content.latin: 73:19 Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi, * et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem.
content.english: 73:19 Deliver not up to beasts the souls that confess to thee: * and forget not to the end the souls of thy poor.

segments.t: Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi, * et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem.

content.latin: 73:20 Réspice in testaméntum tuum: * quia repléti sunt, qui obscuráti sunt terræ dómibus iniquitátum.
content.english: 73:20 Have regard to thy covenant: * for they that are the obscure of the earth have been filled with dwellings of iniquity.

segments.t: Réspice in testaméntum tuum: * quia repléti sunt, qui obscuráti sunt terræ dómibus iniquitátum.

content.latin: 73:21 Ne avertátur húmilis factus confúsus: * pauper et inops laudábunt nomen tuum.
content.english: 73:21 Let not the humble be turned away with confusion: * the poor and needy shall praise thy name.

segments.t: Ne avertátur húmilis factus confúsus: * pauper et inops laudábunt nomen tuum.

content.latin: 73:22 Exsúrge, Deus, iúdica causam tuam: * memor esto improperiórum tuórum, eórum quæ ab insipiénte sunt tota die.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Assúmpsit Iesus * Petrum, et Iacóbum, et Ioánnem fratrem eius, et duxit eos in montem excélsum seórsum, et transfigurátus est ante eos.
content.english: Ant. Jesus took Peter, * and James, and John his brother, and brought them up into an high mountain apart and was transfigured before them.

segments.t: Ant.
Assúmpsit Iesus * Petrum, et Iacóbum, et Ioánnem fratrem eius, et duxit eos in montem excélsum seórsum, et transfigurátus est ante eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 109 [1]
content.english: Psalm 109 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 109

content.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
content.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

segments.t: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:

content.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
content.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

segments.t: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
content.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

segments.t: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
content.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

segments.t: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.

content.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
content.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.

content.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
content.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.t: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

content.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
content.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

segments.t: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

content.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
content.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

segments.t: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. His Face did shine as the sun, * and His raiment exceeding white as snow, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Resplénduit * fácies eius sicut sol, vestiménta autem eius facta sunt alba sicut nix, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 110 [2]
content.english: Psalm 110 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 110

content.latin: 110:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.
content.english: 110:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.

content.latin: 110:2 Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
content.english: 110:2 Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

segments.t: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.

content.latin: 110:3 Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:3 His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 110:4 Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
content.english: 110:4 He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: * he hath given food to them that fear him.

segments.t: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.

content.latin: 110:5 Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
content.english: 110:5 He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

segments.t: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:

content.latin: 110:7 Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
content.english: 110:7 That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

segments.t: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.

content.latin: 110:8 Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
content.english: 110:8 All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

segments.t: Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.

content.latin: 110:9 Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
content.english: 110:9 He hath sent redemption to his people: * he hath commanded his covenant for ever.

segments.t: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.latin: 110:9 (fit reverentia) Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
content.english: 110:9 (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

segments.t: 110:9 (fit reverentia)
Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.

content.latin: 110:10 Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:10 A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. His Face did shine as the sun, and His raiment exceeding white as snow, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Resplénduit fácies eius sicut sol, vestiménta autem eius facta sunt alba sicut nix, allelúia.

content.latin: Ant. Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.
content.english: Ant. And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias, * talking with Jesus.

segments.t: Ant.
Et ecce * apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.

content.latin: Psalmus 111 [3]
content.english: Psalm 111 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 111

content.latin: 111:1 Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.
content.english: 111:1 Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

segments.t: Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.

content.latin: 111:2 Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
content.english: 111:2 His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

segments.t: Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.

content.latin: 111:3 Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 111:3 Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 111:4 Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
content.english: 111:4 To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

segments.t: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.

content.latin: 111:5 Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
content.english: 111:5 Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: he shall order his words with judgment: * because he shall not be moved for ever.

segments.t: Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.

content.latin: 111:7 In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
content.english: 111:7 The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear the evil hearing.

segments.t: In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.

content.latin: 111:7 Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
content.english: 111:7 His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

segments.t: Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.

content.latin: 111:9 Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
content.english: 111:9 He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

segments.t: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.

content.latin: 111:10 Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
content.english: 111:10 The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.

content.english: Ant. And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias, talking with Jesus.

segments.t: Ant.
Et ecce apparuérunt eis Móyses et Elías loquéntes cum Iesu.

content.latin: Ant. Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.
content.english: Ant. Then answered Peter, * and said unto Jesus: Lord, it is good for us to be here.

segments.t: Ant.
Respóndens autem Petrus, * dixit ad Iesum: Dómine, bonum est nos hic esse.

content.latin: Psalmus 112 [4]
content.english: Psalm 112 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 112

content.latin: 112:1 Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:1 Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:2 (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
content.english: 112:2 (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

segments.t: 112:2 (fit reverentia)
Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.

content.latin: 112:3 A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:3 From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

segments.t: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:4 Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
content.english: 112:4 The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

segments.t: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.

content.latin: 112:5 Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
content.english: 112:5 Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

segments.t: Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?

content.latin: 112:7 Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
content.english: 112:7 Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

segments.t: Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:

content.latin: 112:8 Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
content.english: 112:8 That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

segments.t: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.

content.latin: 112:9 Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
content.english: 112:9 Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

segments.t: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.

content.english: Ant. While he yet spake, * behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them.

segments.t: Ant.
Adhuc eo loquénte, * ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 116 [5]
content.english: Psalm 116 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 116

content.latin: 116:1 Laudáte Dóminum, omnes gentes: * laudáte eum, omnes pópuli:
content.english: 116:1 Praise the Lord, all ye nations: * praise him, all ye people.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum, omnes gentes: * laudáte eum, omnes pópuli:

content.latin: 116:2 Quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius: * et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum.
content.english: 116:2 For his mercy is confirmed upon us: * and the truth of the Lord remaineth for ever.

segments.t: Quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius: * et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

segments.t: Ant.
Adhuc eo loquénte, ecce nubes lúcida obumbrávit eos.

content.latin: Salvatórem exspectámus Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, qui reformábit corpus humilitátis nostræ configurátum córpori claritátis suæ.
content.english: We look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious Body.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Quicúmque Christum quǽritis,
content.english: All ye who would the Christ descry,

content.latin: Oculos in altum tóllite:
content.english: Lift up your eyes to him on high:

content.latin: Illic licébit vísere
content.english: There mortal gaze hath strength to see

content.latin: Signum perénnis glóriæ.
content.english: The token of his majesty.

content.latin: Illústre quiddam cérnimus,
content.english: A wondrous sign we there behold,

content.latin: Quod nésciat finem pati,
content.english: That knows not death nor groweth old,

content.latin: Sublíme, celsum, intérminum,
content.english: Sublime, most high, that cannot fade,

content.latin: Antíquius cælo et chao.
content.english: That was ere earth and heaven were made.

content.latin: Hic ille Rex est géntium
content.english: Here is the King the gentiles fear,

content.latin: Populíque Rex iudáici,
content.english: The Jews' most mighty King is here

content.latin: Promíssus Abrahæ patri
content.english: Promised to Abraham of yore,

content.latin: Eiúsque in ævum sémini.
content.english: And to his seed forevermore.

content.latin: Hunc, et prophétis téstibus
content.english: 'Tis he the prophets' words foretold,

content.latin: Iisdémque signatóribus,
content.english: And by their signs shown forth of old;

content.latin: Testátor et Pater iubet
content.english: The Father's witness hath ordained

content.latin: Audíre nos et crédere.
content.english: That we should hear with faith unfeigned.

content.latin: Iesu, tibi sit glória,
content.english: Jesu, to thee our praise we pay,

content.latin: Qui te revélas párvulis,
content.english: To little ones revealed today,

content.latin: Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
content.english: With Father and blest Spirit One

content.latin: In sempitérna sǽcula.
content.english: Until the ages' course is done.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Gloriósus apparuísti in conspéctu Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Thou wast manifested in thy glory in the Presence of the Lord.

segments.t: Gloriósus apparuísti in conspéctu Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Proptérea decórem índuit te Dóminus.
content.english: ℟. Therefore the Lord hath clothed thee with majesty.

segments.t: Proptérea decórem índuit te Dóminus.

content.latin: Ant. Et audiéntes * discípuli cecidérunt in fáciem suam et timuérunt valde: et accéssit Iesus, et tétigit eos dixítque eis: Súrgite et nolíte timére, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, * and were sore afraid and Jesus came and touched them, and said unto them: Arise, and be not afraid, alleluia.

content.latin: Deus, qui fídei sacraménta in Unigéniti tui gloriósa Transfiguratióne patrum testimónio roborásti, et adoptiónem filiórum perféctam, voce delápsa in nube lúcida, mirabíliter præsignásti: concéde propítius; ut ipsíus Regis glóriæ nos coherédes effícias, et eiúsdem glóriæ tríbuas esse consórtes.
content.english: O God, Who, in the glorious Transfiguration of thine Only Begotten Son didst attest the mysteries of the Faith by the witness of the Fathers, and didst wonderfully signify by a voice out of a bright cloud, the adoption of sons, mercifully grant unto us to be made co-heirs with the very King of glory, and bestow upon us a partaking of His glory.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:

content.english: May the almighty ✠ and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

content.latin: 4:2 Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus iustítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
content.english: 4:2 When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me: * when I was in distress, thou hast enlarged me.

content.latin: 4:3 Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
content.english: 4:3 O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? * Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?

segments.t: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?

content.latin: 4:4 Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
content.english: 4:4 Know ye also that the Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: * the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.

segments.t: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.

content.latin: 4:5 Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
content.english: 4:5 Be ye angry, and sin not: * the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

segments.t: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.

content.latin: 4:6 Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
content.english: 4:6 Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord: * many say, Who sheweth us good things?

segments.t: Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?

content.latin: 4:7 Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
content.english: 4:7 The light of thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: * thou hast given gladness in my heart.

segments.t: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.

content.english: 4:9 In peace in the selfsame * I will sleep, and I will rest:

segments.t: In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;

content.latin: 4:10 Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.
content.english: 4:10 For thou, O Lord, singularly * hast settled me in hope.
